description: Read-only .NET library for Xbox 360 STFS packages and GOD/SVOD containers. Lists and extracts XBLA/XBLIG/Community Games packages, validates the STFS SHA-1 hash tree, reads XContent title metadata, and exposes GOD fragment sets as a seekable stream. Zero dependencies, trimmable and AOT-compatible.
